baseline: Frozen Phase 4 app, isolated import; exact source file SHA256 fingerprints included.

methodology.annotations: Independent static clauses, canonical names, all three classifications, origins, metadata and negative examples were written before analyzer execution.
methodology.technical_mention_unit: A unique canonical name on each independently annotated source clause. The same name on a different clause is another unit; aliases within one clause are one unit.
methodology.technical_pairing: One-to-one canonical names anchored to independently positive source spans, independent of predicted classification/category.
methodology.classification_and_origin_denominator: All expected clauses, including required, preferred, unspecified and extraction misses. Missing baseline origin is qualification.
methodology.metadata: Exact title/company/location/employment_type/work_mode across all cases. Explicit-value and expected-null checks are additionally reported separately, avoiding a majority-null headline.
methodology.source_evidence: Predicted requirements must have exact original Unicode offsets and quotes contained within their independently positive clause. Oversized quotes spanning unrelated text receive no evidence credit. Metadata evidence has its own explicit-field denominator; missing baseline evidence is incorrect.
methodology.false_positive_denominator: All independently annotated excluded clauses, not predicted skills or requirements. A negative clause leaking into any requirement is one false positive.
methodology.unsupported_requirement: A predicted row with no independently positive source clause, a source/category/technical-fact error, or an environment-only mention promoted to a qualification or required/preferred status.
methodology.baseline_isolation: Frozen app imported by --app-root in a separate interpreter, with no current app model or vocabulary imports.

limitations: Fourteen fictional posts are development regressions, not representative real-world performance, independent holdouts or employment outcome evidence.
The same expectations score before and after. New tests intentionally guide implementation; expectations must not be changed just to obtain passing metrics.
Source-bound clause grouping can penalize a valid alternative extraction grouping; inspect per-case differences.
False-positive rates apply only to the explicitly annotated negative clauses and cannot be extrapolated to arbitrary job advertisements.
